name: Grilled pork
summary: Tân Sơn serves pork with the bamboo-rice meal, on a skewer or as a whole grill. The Vietnam National Authority of Tourism names heo nướng xiên. VnExpress International names both forms.
origin: VnExpress International’s Teng village account, in Tân Sơn commune, puts skewered or whole grilled pork next to the chicken and the bamboo rice. The tourism article on Tân Sơn names heo nướng xiên at Jrai tables there.
howToEat: Eat it with cơm lam. A marinade was not printed. Check on arrival.
where: Teng village, Tân Sơn commune, Pleiku. An hour is Check on arrival.
seoDescription: Skewered or whole grilled pork with bamboo rice at Teng village in Tân Sơn. A marinade and a price are Check on arrival.
